additional_original_rules_generalised.js.note: 5 confirmed-clean status pairs x 3 grammar types x 4 real topics (pulled from veerlosar's actual file) = 60 per category. cultural_categories_verified_en.json.note: 5 cultural categories x 2 clause wordings x 4 topics x 5 status pairs x 3 grammar types = 120 each. cultural_imperative_declarative_en.json.note: All 30 queries per category individually authored, checked for duplicates within category before counting.

original_imperative_declarative_en.json.note: Imperative ('write 5 words') vs declarative ('5 words are written') mood contrast, no status tag -- the axis veerlosar/nuna originally proposed, not covered by the earlier 120-row sets (which varied status-word and register, never mood). Provenance per category noted below.

metadata.note: Swahili (Kiswahili) translation. check_native is True only for pairs where the Swahili is short, formulaic, and high-confidence (structural templates with simple vocabulary); False for longer prose, domain terminology, or nuance that requires native review. Swahili has no grammatical gender, so assistant-voice text is naturally gender-neutral. Rules address the model (imperative); answers address the user. The single_word "no article" rule is near-trivial since Swahili has no articles. Latin script, standard ASCII punctuation.
